#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PREFLIGHT_REQUIRES: static-only
#
# MUTATION PAYLOAD — NOT A SMOKE SCRIPT. DO NOT "FIX" THE DEFECT BELOW.
#
# scripts/smoke/phase-224.sh copies this file into a THROWAWAY fixture corpus
# (under $TMPDIR, never the working tree) as `scripts/smoke/phase-02.sh` and
# asserts that scripts/drift-audit.sh's "smoke regex portability" guard reports
# a FAIL for it. The defect is deliberate and is the whole point of the file.
#
# It is stored with a `.txt` suffix so the live repository's own guards skip it:
# drift-audit globs `scripts/smoke/*.sh` (not `*.sh.txt`) for the escape scan
# and greps `scripts --include='*.sh'` for the mktemp scan. Renaming this file
# to `.sh` would make the real audit FAIL on the repository itself.
#
# THE SHAPE IS DELIBERATE. `[^\n]` is written as the SECOND argument of a
# file-first helper on a BACKSLASH-CONTINUED line. That is the hardest shape
# the guard has to see, and it is the exact shape that defeated the guard's
# first cut (a single-line `grep -rnE` could not join the continuation, and the
# helper alternation named only five of the corpus's eight grep-shaped
# helpers). A payload written as a one-line `assert_grep_present` call would
# pass against the OLD broken guard too, and would therefore prove nothing.

set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
cd "${ROOT}"

# shellcheck source=scripts/smoke/common.sh
source "scripts/smoke/common.sh"

WIRE_GO='internal/fixture/fixture.go'

assert_not_grep "${WIRE_GO}" \
    'ExtraSystemBlocks[^\n]*map\[' \
    'fixture: blocks are an ordered slice, never a map'

smoke_summary
